music: Bright friendly upbeat pop bed, 120 bpm, no vocals
lines: Here's how to edit a PowerPoint in ReStyles.
Choose Edit a finished deck, or build from a template you bought.
Drop in the PowerPoint. ReStyles reads every slide and shows you the words.
Say what to change. Names, dates, numbers. Then apply.
Download your PowerPoint. It's still a real, editable file.
Your deck, your words, still yours to edit.
